desc: JupyterLab is an extensible environment for interactive and reproducible computing, based on the Jupyter Notebook Architecture. From 4.5.7 until 4.5.11 and 4.6.4, the markdownviewer:trust and notebook:trust command-link handlers use tracker.currentWidget to resolve the current Markdown viewer or notebook when the user answers rather than retaining the document whose command button was clicked. title: Plane: XSS in work item comments
desc: Plane is an open-source project management tool. Prior to 1.4.0, the plane comments fail to sanitize unsafe URL schemes stored in comment_html. A project member can store a crafted link in a comment, and attacker-controlled script executes in the browser context of another user who selects the link. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.0.

desc: Metabase is an open source business intelligence and analytics platform. From 1.55.0 until 1.58.16, 1.59.13, 1.60.9, and 1.61.4, native queries and actions against an H2 data source are passed through without restricting host-facing built-in functions. A user authorized to run native queries or actions can invoke FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, CSVREAD, CSVWRITE, or LINK_SCHEMA to read or write arbitrary f

title: Fixed values in MongoDB Server $bucket stage may be misread as field references
desc: An issue in MongoDB Server's aggregation framework can cause certain constant values to be handled incorrectly during internal query rewriting. Under certain conditions, an authenticated user with read access may receive field values in aggregation output that the query did not intend to return.

title: copyparty FTP: upload outside defined volumes (limited path traversal)
desc: copyparty is a portable file server. Prior to 1.20.19, FTP upload path handling does not confine destinations to configured copyparty volumes. When FTP or FTPS is explicitly enabled, a low-privileged authenticated user can submit traversal paths during upload to create a new file outside configured volumes wherever the copyparty process has write permission. The attacker cannot read or overwrite f

title: Indico: Cross-Site-Scripting in minutes editor
desc: Indico is an event management system that uses Flask-Multipass, a multi-backend authentication system for Flask. Prior to 3.3.13, users who can create content, including speakers who can create minutes, can store crafted HTML in event minutes. When concurrent edits are made to the same minutes, the minute editor conflict UI can execute attacker-controlled script in the viewer's browser in the Indi

title: Banks: User-controlled prompt input can be parsed as privileged chat messages
desc: Banks generates meaningful LLM prompts using a simple template language. Prior to 2.5.0, Banks Prompt.chat_messages() attempts to parse every line of rendered template output as ChatMessage JSON. When an application renders untrusted data and passes the returned ChatMessage objects to an LLM provider, attacker-controlled JSON can cross the prompt boundary and become a system, assistant, or tool me

desc: fast-jwt provides fast JSON Web Token (JWT) implementation. desc: Strawberry GraphQL is a library for creating GraphQL APIs. From 0.312.3 until 0.327.2, the legacy graphql-ws subscription handler in strawberry/subscriptions/protocols/graphql_ws/handlers.py does not remove naturally completed operations from self.tasks and self.subscriptions. When max_subscriptions_per_connection is configured, a client on a persistent WebSocket connection can use distinct operat

title: SumatraPDF: Markup/command-link injection into UI notification text
desc: SumatraPDF is a multi-format reader for Windows. In 3.6.1 and earlier, untrusted document paths and PDF link targets are interpolated into notification text that ParseTip() interprets as trusted tip markup. When a user clicks an injected link, ExecuteTipLink() dispatches its CmdExec command and can execute an attacker-selected local program in the user's context. No broader impact is claimed beyon

title: SumatraPDF CHM `its://` signed index causes an out-of-bounds object lookup
desc: SumatraPDF is a multi-format reader for Windows. In 3.6.1 and earlier, and in pre-release 3.7.0.20369 when WebView2 is absent or cannot initialize, ParseProtoUrl() accepts the signed host component of an its:// URL and FindHtmlWindowById() uses it directly as an index into gHtmlWindows. Opening a crafted CHM through the IE fallback backend with a negative or otherwise out-of-range window identifie

title: Dromara Skyeye Unauthenticated OS Command Injection via textToSpeech format Parameter
desc: Dromara Skyeye through commit 003549ae5615bd114ba5bb8ddf6a8e8ead97c321 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the unauthenticated /post/TtsController/textToSpeech endpoint via the format parameter. Attackers can inject a single quote into format to break out of the PowerShell string and execute commands as the Skyeye service account on Windows.

title: Jivejdon through commit ee67a65e Missing Authorization via /message/threadToForum/save Thread Move
desc: Jivejdon from commit d58a36b0 through commit ee67a65e contains a missing authorization vulnerability in UpdateThreadToForumAction that allows authenticated users to move other users' threads. Attackers can send crafted threadId and forumId values to /message/threadToForum/save to relocate any reply-less thread into an arbitrary forum.

title: Jivejdon through 5.0 Stored XSS via messageListBody.jsp Forum Message Rendering
desc: Jivejdon through 5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to inject script by posting unsanitized forum message bodies. Message bodies are rendered by messageListBody.jsp with filter="false" and non-escaping default filters, executing script in the browser of every user viewing the thread.

title: Jivejdon through commit ee67a65e Missing Rate Limiting via /account/smsVRAction SMS Endpoint
desc: Jivejdon from commit e0306088 through commit ee67a65e lacks rate limiting on the unauthenticated /account/smsVRAction endpoint handled by SmsQQAction, allowing unlimited SMS sending. Attackers can load newAccount.jsp to set session attributes, then repeatedly call the endpoint to harass arbitrary phone numbers and exhaust the operator's Tencent Cloud SMS balance.

desc: OpenPrinting CUPS before 2.4.20 contains a NULL pointer dereference caused by repeated IPP group tags in job-creation requests. IPP parsing creates unnamed separator attributes with IPP_TAG_ZERO, but add_job() converts these separators to IPP_TAG_JOB. During job startup, get_options()/ipp_length() subsequently calls strlen() on a NULL attribute name, terminating cupsd and disrupting all queues. A

title: Netcore NR268 CGI Execution user_ok improper authentication
desc: A vulnerability was determined in Netcore NR268 1.7.121109. Affected is the function user_ok of the component CGI Execution. This manipulation causes improper authentication. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: Edimax BR-6208AC formWlanMP buffer overflow
desc: A vulnerability has been found in Edimax BR-6208AC 1.32. This affects an unknown part of the file /goform/formWlanMP. Such manipulation of the argument ateBW leads to buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects

title: SourceCodester Drug Recommendation System Student Registration add_student.php cross site scripting
desc: A weakness has been identified in SourceCodester Drug Recommendation System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file Auth/add_student.php of the component Student Registration. This manipulation of the argument txtname/txtpassword/txtemail/txtphone/txtprevious_school causes cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the pu

title: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 Unauthenticated Stored XSS via Registration Name
desc: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 contains an unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in RegistrationPresenter.php, which inserts the raw FIRST_NAME registration value into an unencoded data-message attribute. Attackers can register with a double-quoted event handler that executes JavaScript in an administrator's session when they hover the entry on the Manage registrations page.

title: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Record Read via RETURN FETCH
desc: SurrealDB from 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated record users to read records in other namespaces or databases by resolving record ids through FETCH. Attackers can switch to a foreign namespace/database and name a known record id in a RETURN … FETCH query to read another tenant's data when table PERMISSIONS allow reads.

title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Denial of Service via Headers Non-ASCII Values
desc: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows query-capable users to crash the server by reading non-ASCII header values in embedded JavaScript. Attackers with scripting enabled can read such values via Headers get(), entries(), values(), or getSetCookie(), or return them from fetch() endpoints, aborting the server process.

title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Access via USE Statement
desc: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 allows cross-tenant access because the SurrealQL USE statement switches a session to any namespace/database without checking that the caller's authenticated level covers it. Authenticated namespace, database, or record users can switch to another tenant and read, create, update, or delete rows in tables whose PERMISSIONS allow it, such as PERMISSIONS FULL.

title: Gitoxide gix-mailmap before 0.35.0 CPU Denial of Service via .mailmap Parsing
desc: Gitoxide gix-mailmap before 0.35.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic-time parsing in Snapshot::from_bytes. Attackers can commit a crafted .mailmap with descending-ordered entries forcing repeated front inserts, blocking workers running log, blame, or shortlog for minutes.

title: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 SQL Injection via notification_id in notifications.inc.php
desc: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unprivileged users to inject SQL by supplying an array-valued notification_id parameter to notifications.inc.php. Attackers can perform cross-table reads of users.password hashes, with results persisted in notifications_attribs and readable through the interface.

title: Edgeless Systems Contrast 1.8.0 before 1.24.1 World-Writable Containerd Config Privilege Escalation
desc: Edgeless Systems Contrast 1.8.0 before 1.24.1 contains an incorrect permissions vulnerability where the node installer writes the containerd config world-writable (0666). Local unprivileged users on the node can modify the containerd config, for example overwriting the runc location, to escalate privileges.

title: Zebra 6.4.0 before 6.4.2 Denial of Service via Malformed v6 Transaction
desc: ZcashFoundation Zebra 6.4.0 before 6.4.2 parses version 6 transactions carrying a pre-NU6.3 consensus branch ID, but the size computation during UnminedTx construction treats re-serialization of the Orchard bundle as infallible, so the resulting error trips an expect that aborts zebrad. Unauthenticated peers can send a single pre-handshake tx message to crash the node, and can repeat this after ea

title: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 Account Takeover via SAML Identity-Provider Confusion
desc: ZITADEL 4.x before 4.19.2 and 3.x through 3.4.15 contains an authentication bypass in the SAML identity-provider intent callback, which verifies the assertion signature using the provider named in the request URL but resolves the user from the login intent without checking they match. Attackers with organization-administrator permission can register a SAML provider with their own signing key to ob

title: Hugo v0.60.0 before v0.167.0 Stored XSS via Table of Contents Heading IDs
desc: Hugo from v0.60.0 before v0.167.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows Markdown content authors to inject HTML by supplying crafted explicit heading IDs. Attackers can break out of the unescaped href attribute in .TableOfContents or .Fragments.ToHTML output to inject elements with event handlers into rendered pages.

title: Frappe before v16.31.0 Stored XSS via Dashboard Chart Filters
desc: Frappe before 15.118.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in dashboard chart filters because jQuery renders entered filter values as rich text. Authenticated attackers can store malicious filter values that execute scripts in the browsers of users who view the dashboard chart.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Document Modification
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 and 16.x before 16.32.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability because certain endpoints fail to enforce proper permission checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints to modify documents and data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 Missing Authorization in Document Creation Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper permission checks during document creation. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints to create documents against records beyond their permitted role, bypassing role-based access controls.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.1 Unauthorized Document Modification via Missing Authorization
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.1 and 16.x before 16.34.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper authorization checks. Authenticated attackers can send requests to these endpoints to modify documents and data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 Unauthorized Status Modification via Missing Authorization
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper role checks when modifying record status. Authenticated low-privileged attackers can invoke these endpoints to alter data beyond their permitted role, compromising data integrity.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 Stored XSS via Public Booking Page
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 and 16.x before 16.32.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because content submitted through a public-facing booking page is stored without neutralization. Unauthenticated attackers can submit crafted content that is rendered as raw HTML in a privileged user's session, executing script to act as that user and take over the account.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 SQL Injection via Missing Input Validation
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 and 16.x before 16.21.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints caused by missing input validation. Authenticated attackers can send specially crafted requests to these endpoints to manipulate database queries and extract sensitive information from the database.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.111.0 Missing Authorization Exposes Project Data
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.111.0 and 16.x before 16.22.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain project-related endpoints that fail to enforce permission checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints directly to read project data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.106.0 SQL Injection via Missing Input Validation
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.106.0 and 16.x before 16.16.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints due to missing input validation. Authenticated attackers can send specially crafted requests to inject SQL into database queries and extract sensitive information from the underlying database.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Stored XSS Leading to Account Takeover
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because record fields are rendered into an HTML attribute context without escaping. A low-privilege user can store a malicious payload in a record field that executes in the browser of any privileged user who opens the affected page, enabling account takeover.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.115.0 Missing Authorization on Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.115.0 and 16.x before 16.26.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in which certain endpoints fail to enforce proper authorization checks. Authenticated users can call these endpoints to read data, including personal data, beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.113.0 SQL Injection via Unvalidated Endpoint Parameters
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.113.0 and 16.x before 16.22.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability caused by missing input validation in some endpoints. Authenticated remote attackers can send specially crafted requests to these endpoints to manipulate database queries and extract sensitive information from the database.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 Missing Authorization in Party Record Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 and 16.x before 16.21.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that handle party records, allowing authenticated users to modify data beyond their permitted role. Attackers with low-privileged accounts can send requests to these endpoints to make unauthorized changes to party records.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 16.12.0 Stored XSS via Crafted Record Names
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.103.0 and 16.x before 16.12.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the names of certain records are not properly neutralized when rendered on some dashboards, tools, and portals. title: FreeRDP 2.0.0-beta1 before 3.28.0 Out-of-Bounds Read via LocateCardsByATRA Handler
desc: FreeRDP from 2.0.0-beta1 before 3.28.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in smartcard_LocateCardsByATRA_Call because the ATR pattern cbAtr byte count is not capped. Malicious RDP servers can send crafted ATR mask arrays to use query timing as an oracle, leaking heap memory bit-by-bit to defeat ASLR and aid RCE exploits.

title: FreeRDP 3.27.1 before 3.32.0 NULL Pointer Dereference via Cache Bitmap V3 Order
desc: FreeRDP 3.27.1 before 3.32.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference in update_read_cache_bitmap_v3_order() in libfreerdp/core/orders.c, which accesses the client bitmap cache when the CBR3_DO_NOT_CACHE flag is set, even though the cache is not yet initialized before Demand Active. title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Reachable Assertion via Stale Smartcard Handle
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 does not remove card handles when Emulate_SCardReleaseContext releases a smartcard-emulation context, so Emulate_SCardTransmit later looks up the deleted parent context and reaches a terminating WINPR_ASSERT. title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 PIN Brute-Force via Virtual Smartcard
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts in its virtual smartcard GIDS implementation, which stores the PIN retry counter per-handle. A malicious RDP server can exhaust the counter with VERIFY APDUs, then request a new SCardConnect to reset attempts, enabling unbounded online brute-forcing of the configured smartcard PIN.

title: Parse Server 9.0.0 before 9.10.2-alpha.5 Transactional Batch Request Write Interference
desc: Parse Server 5.4.0 before 8.6.96 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.2-alpha.5 shares transactional batch state across concurrent requests, letting any client's transactional batch request interfere with other clients' database writes. title: EspoCRM 4.0.0 before 10.0.7 Field-Level Security Bypass via Note Read Endpoint
desc: EspoCRM 4.0.0 before 10.0.7 contains an access control vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read audited field values restricted by field-level security by fetching individual stream notes. Users with stream access to a parent record can request GET /Note/{id}, which skips the NoteAccessControl filter, and recover data.attributes.was and became values of restricted fields.

title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 Heap Buffer Underwrite in PICT Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 contains a heap buffer underwrite vulnerability in DecodeImage() in coders/pict.c on 32-bit builds due to pointer arithmetic overflow. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with maximized row, column and bytes-per-line values to bypass bounds checks and write up to 128 controlled bytes below the heap buffer, causing crashes or code execution.

title: WordPress Smart Forms plugin <= 2.6.104 - Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
desc: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in EDGARROJAS Smart Forms smart-forms allows DOM-Based XSS.This issue affects Smart Forms: from n/a through 2.6.104.

title: Enforce maximum recursion depth in encoding/asn1
desc: Enforce a recursion limit in Unmarshal to prevent stack exhaustion when parsing deeply-nested, recursive structures.

title: WordPress Gmedia Photo Gallery plugin <= 1.25.1 - SQL Injection vulnerability
desc: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Serhii Pasyuk Gmedia Photo Gallery grand-media allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Gmedia Photo Gallery: from n/a through 1.25.1.

title: Quadratic complexity in WordDecoder.DecodeHeader in mime
desc: Decoding a maliciously-crafted MIME header containing many invalid encoded-words can consume excessive CPU.

title: WordPress Tutor LMS plugin <= 4.1.0 - Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
desc: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themeum Tutor LMS tutor allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Tutor LMS: from n/a through 4.1.0.

desc: OAuthLib is an implementation of the OAuth request-signing logic for Python 3.6+. title: ConnectBot SSH: Excessive allocation and integer overflow in DER private-key parsing
desc: ConnectBot SSH Client Library is written in Kotlin with Kaitai Struct and KStateMachine. Prior to 0.3.1, DerReader.readLength() accepts excessive long-form DER length octets, accumulates them into an Int, and primitive readers allocate arrays without checking the declared size against the remaining input. title: Salty documentation workflow executes fork-controlled Python build hooks with deployment secrets
desc: The Salty documentation repository builds and deploys the docs.saltbox.dev website. Prior to commit 649c9aea2daef1168eeb0415b44e65dbbde9f220, .github/workflows/trigger-pr-build.yml records an untrusted fork commit in the pr_info artifact, and the secret-bearing workflow_run job in .github/workflows/build-pr.yml checks out that commit before running pip install -r requirements.txt. title: FearlessCMS: Remote Code Execution via Unvalidated Update Repository URL in System Updater
desc: FearlessCMS is a flat-file content management system centered on simplicity and open source. In 0.1.2b and earlier, an authenticated administrator can set an arbitrary Git repository URL through admin/updater-handler.php and trigger perform_update, which passes the URL to update.sh. The updater clones the repository and replaces the live plugins/, admin/, and includes/ directories without verifyin

title: ConvertX: Path Traversal vulnerability leading to Arbitrary File Write
desc: ConvertX is a self-hosted file conversion service. Prior to 0.18.0, the ImageMagick converter uses the unsanitized convert_to parameter to construct an output path. title: Affected devices do not properly validate and sanitize visual properties of calculated signals contained in imported CSV
desc:
Affected devices do not properly validate and sanitize visual properties of calculated signals contained in imported CSV trace files before rendering them on the Trace page.

This could allow an attacker to social engineer an authorized user who holds the function right “Read diagnostics” into importing a specially crafted trace file. Successful exploitation could allow attacker-controlled JavaS

title: Affected devices do not properly sanitize calculated signal names contained in imported CSV trace files before including
desc:
Affected devices do not properly sanitize calculated signal names contained in imported CSV trace files before including them in error messages on the Trace page.

title: Wazuh 3.9.0 before 4.14.8 Memory Exhaustion via SCA YAML Alias Expansion
desc: Wazuh from 3.9.0 before 4.14.8 contains an uncontrolled YAML alias expansion vulnerability in yaml2json_node that allows a manager-controlled policy to exhaust agent memory. Attackers controlling the manager can push a small SCA policy with nested aliases via merged.mg to OOM-kill wazuh-modulesd on every agent in a group.

title: Wazuh 4.6.0 before 4.14.8 Authentication Bypass via Empty Password in update_user
desc: Wazuh versions from 4.6.0 before 4.14.8 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability where security.update_user places the reserved user guard and password policy inside a falsy truthiness check. A delegated user administrator can send an empty password to the user update endpoint, bypassing the reserved user guard to take over the wazuh superuser account and authenticate with empty credentials.

title: Wazuh 4.1.1 before 4.14.8 Path Traversal via Cluster Upload Functions
desc: Wazuh from 4.1.1 before 4.14.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability in upload_list_file, upload_rule_file, and upload_decoder_file that allows malicious cluster workers to write files at arbitrary paths. Attackers holding the cluster key can send DistributedAPI requests with ../ sequences in filename, bypassing REST controller validation, to write files as the wazuh user.

desc: OpENer v2.3.0 / commit 76b95cf contains an out-of-bounds read in the unconnected explicit messaging path. This allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service.

desc: EIPStackGroup OpENer v2.3 and master up to commit 76b95cf contain an expired pointer dereference vulnerability in the EtherNet/IP Common Packet Format (CPF) handling logic. This allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service.

title: Openstack-network-exporter: basic-auth uses plaintext password storage and non-constant-time comparison
desc: A flaw was found in openstack-network-exporter. When an operator configures user authentication but omits or misconfigures Transport Layer Security (TLS), the basic authentication mechanism is silently bypassed. title: Openstack-network-exporter: http.server has no readheadertimeout / readtimeout (slowloris)
desc: A flaw was found in openstack-network-exporter. The HTTP server within the component is configured without essential timeout settings, such as ReadHeaderTimeout. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to initiate multiple slow HTTP header connections. By trickling header bytes, the attacker can exhaust server resources, specifically file descriptors, leading to a Denial of S

title: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly restri
desc: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly restrict access to sensitive configuration items via specific database queries. This could allow an authenticated attacker to retrieve administrative credentials for various internal systems, leading to unauthorized information disclosure and privilege escalation.

desc: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly restrict access to database queries used for subnet management. This could allow an authenticated attacker to read, modify, or delete subnet configurations, leading to unauthorized information disclosure and data manipulation.

desc: A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly perform server-side authorization checks for requests to modify the state of scheduled actions. This could allow an authenticated attacker with minimal privileges to retry, stop, or delete scheduled tasks without proper authorization.

desc: A vulnerability has been identified in Capital Embedded AR Classic 431-422 (All versions), Capital Embedded AR Classic R20-11 (All versions < V2303), Desigo PXC00-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC00-U (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC001-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC100-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC12-E.D (All versions >= V2.3), Desigo PXC128-U (All versions >= V2.3), Desig

title: MongoDB Server may disclose process memory via a crafted `$_internalApplyOplogUpdate` aggregation pipeline
desc: Use of freed memory in the aggregation feature of MongoDB Server can cause the server to read data from a memory area after it has been released. When an internal aggregation stage is combined with a batch size of 0, the server may read from memory that is no longer in use. title: Missing Authorization Check on Internal Aggregation Stage in MongoDB Server mongos Leads to Denial of Service
desc: A security issue was discovered in MongoDB mongos (the sharded cluster router) where an authenticated user with readWrite privileges could crash the mongos process by crafting a specially formed aggregation pipeline. title: A CSRF vulnerability exists in certain NETGEAR XR series devices
desc: A cross site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the listed NETGEAR models allows an attacker who can leverage social engineering techniques on a router administrator to tamper with router configuration and disrupt router operations with active assistance from the router administrator. There is no confidentiality impact due to this vulnerability.

title: Insufficient input validation vulnerability exists in certain NETGEAR RAX Models
desc: An insufficient input validation vulnerability in the listed NETGEAR RAX series models allows a network-adjacent attacker having network access (such as WiFi credentials) to crash the router's management UI. There is no confidentiality or integrity impact. A crash of the router's management UI does not impact the availability of the router's core services like WiFi network.

title: Servor 1.0.0 through 4.0.2 Unauthenticated Path Traversal via URL-Encoded Dot Segments
desc: Servor 1.0.0 through 4.0.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to escape the served root by sending URL-encoded dot segments. Attackers can send %2e%2e/ sequences, which decodeURI() decodes before path.join() in serveStaticFile and serveDirectoryListing, to read arbitrary files and list directories outside the root.

privilege escalation, and further impact on Confidentiality, Integrity, and
Availability.

When Bleve search is enabled and a restricted authenticated user searches the global index for content

desc: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17.0 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user holding a custom role with compliance framework administration permissions to configure and execute a specially crafted compliance pipeline across group projects due to improper privilege assi

title: OWASP Coraza WAF: jsDecode Off-by-One in Octal Escape Handling Enables WAF Bypass
desc: OWASP Coraza WAF is a golang modsecurity compatible web application firewall library. From 3.0.0 until 3.8.0, the t:jsDecode transformation in internal/transformations/js_decode.go:64-70 includes the backslash in the octal buffer, causing ParseInt to fail and return a null byte. desc: Authentication bypass by spoofing in ICS before version 25.1.3.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. This does not impact ICS version 22.7R2.14 or prior.

title: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision in GitLab
desc: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 19.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user holding a specific granular permission to obtain a GitLab Duo Agent Platform token that bypasses governance controls, due to reliance on untrusted input in a security decision.

title: Jexactyl: Free-billing order endpoint renews and unsuspends arbitrary servers by ID (missing ownership check)
desc: Jexactyl is a customisable game management panel and billing system. From 4.0.0 until 4.0.5, the POST /api/client/billing/free/process endpoint accepts a client-controlled server_id and loads the server without restricting the lookup to servers owned by the authenticated account. title: Insufficient input validation vulnerability in NETGEAR R7300 router
desc: Insufficient input validation vulnerability in the PPPoE Setup feature of NETGEAR R7300 router allows authenticated administrators connected to the local network to perform unauthorized actions on the router. This issue was identified through testing in a controlled research environment using a simulated version of the router's software and has not been confirmed on physical production devices.

title: Insufficient input validation vulnerability in NETGEAR R7300
desc: Insufficient input validation vulnerability in the LAN Setup feature of NETGEAR R7300 router allows authenticated administrators connected to the local network to perform unauthorized actions on the router.This issue was identified through testing in a controlled research environment using a simulated version of the router's software and has not been confirmed on physical production devices.

desc: Tina is a headless content management system. Prior to 0.2.1, the tina-markdown element in packages/@tinacms/web-components/src/tina-markdown.js assigns a rich-text node.url value directly to an anchor href without validating the URL scheme. A content author can store a link using a script-capable scheme, and a visitor who clicks the rendered link executes attacker-controlled script in the site's

title: Wizarr: Authenticated Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in wizard step rendering leads to Remote Code Execution (RCE)
desc: Wizarr is an advanced user invitation and management system for Jellyfin, Plex, Emby, and other media servers. Prior to 2026.9.1, wizard step Markdown supplied through the editor or imported bundles was evaluated by app/blueprints/wizard/routes.py in the application's non-sandboxed Jinja2 environment with application globals exposed. An authenticated user able to create steps, or an administrator

title: Privasys Go fork: RA-TLS challenge mode did not bind attestation evidence to the TLS session
desc: Privasys Go is a maintained fork of the Go programming language that adds RA-TLS support to crypto/tls. Prior to privasys-v0.5.1-go1.26.5, challenge-mode RA-TLS certificates bound quote ReportData to the certificate public key and client nonce but not to the active TLS session. title: Privasys attested TLS accepted evidence from any unrevoked TEE platform (diversion attack)
desc: Privasys Remote Attestation TLS Clients provides multi-language utilities for verifying attested TLS connections. title: Cairo-dock Glx-Dock Query Parameter ww_page.php cross site scripting
desc: A vulnerability was detected in Cairo-dock Glx-Dock up to 3.4.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file ww_page.php of the component Query Parameter Handler. desc: A weakness has been identified in Linksys E1700 1.0.0.4.003. The affected element is the function setDMZ of the file /goform/setDMZ. desc: A flaw has been found in tobychui zoraxy up to 3.3.4. This impacts the function handleBasicAuth of the file mod/dynamicproxy/authProviders.go of the component Path Exception Matcher. desc: A security flaw has been discovered in itsourcecode Baptism Information Management System 1.0. This affects an unknown part of the file ebaptism.php. The manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

desc: A vulnerability has been found in Netcore NR268 1.7.121109. The impacted element is the function ddns_wan_list_show of the file ddns_wan_list_show.cgi of the component DDNS Handler. title: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 IDOR via /anyone/file/findUrlById
desc: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to obtain storage URLs for other users' files by supplying arbitrary file ids. Attackers can send another user's file ids to the findUrlById handler of FileAnyoneController, which never checks ownership, to retrieve access URLs and read uploaded attachments.

title: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 Missing Authorization via invoice check endpoint
desc: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated back-office user to approve or reject invoices via POST /admin-api/crm/invoice/check. The CrmInvoiceController check handler lacks @PreAuthorize and approver checks are commented out, letting attackers bypass the invoice approval workflow by supplying any invoice id.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Missing Authorization via /log Audit Endpoints
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in LogController that allows any authenticated user to forge, modify, or delete audit log entries. Low-privilege users can call /log/add, /log/update, /log/delete, and /log/deleteBatch to fabricate entries, rewrite user and IP fields, or erase records to hide activity.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Approval Bypass via addDepotHeadAndDetail Status Parameter
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to create pre-approved bills by setting status in POST /depotHead/addDepotHeadAndDetail requests. Attackers can supply a status of 1 to skip audit permission checks and multi-level approval workflows, creating audited bills that affect stock and report queries.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Missing Authorization in Master Data Add and Import Endpoints
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege authenticated users to create tenant-wide master data via add and import endpoints lacking role checks. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints like /account/add, /material/add, or /material/importExcel to create settlement accounts, products with initial stock, departments and dictionary entries.

title: Quay: build trigger uuid idor in quay api
desc: A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. The build trigger management application programming interface (API) fails to verify whether a requested trigger belongs to the specified repository. An authenticated user with administrative access to any repository can view, modify, or permanently delete build triggers and associated write tokens of another repository if they know the victim trigger's universall

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Missing Authorization in DocumentService
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in SoapDocumentService operations that allows authenticated users to access and modify unauthorized documents. Attackers can call copy, getExtractedText, deleteVersion, reindex, deleteLink, or restore via SOAP or /services/rest/document with sequential document IDs to disclose, delete, or tamper with documents.

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Username Enumeration via AvatarServlet
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a username enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid accounts because the AvatarServlet (/avatar) performs no session validation. Attackers can supply usernames or numeric IDs in the userId parameter and compare 1x1 transparent images against real avatars to enumerate users and retrieve profile pictures.

title: SGLang through 0.5.21 Decompression Bomb DoS via NanoNemotronVLImageProcessor
desc: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a denial of service vulnerability that disables Pillow decompression bomb protection process-wide by setting Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS to None in NanoNemotronVLImageProcessor. Remote attackers can submit small, highly compressed images with huge dimensions to the generic image loader, exhausting worker memory during decoding.

title: Crawl4AI 0.7.0 before 0.9.4 SSRF via link_preview_config URL Seeder
desc: Crawl4AI 0.7.0 before 0.9.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows API clients to reach internal addresses by enabling link_preview_config on /crawl requests. Attackers can supply a controlled page with include_external and include_patterns set, causing AsyncUrlSeeder to fetch internal, private, and cloud-metadata links and return their parsed head data.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Insecure Permissions on Soft-Smartcard Private Key File
desc: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows local users to read private keys written by crypto_write_pem without owner-only permissions. Attackers on multi-user Unix hosts can enumerate the shared temporary directory during soft-smartcard logon to read the world-readable PKINIT private-key copy.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via WinPR Clipboard cFileName
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read in the WinPR clipboard function convert_filedescriptors_to_file_list(), which scans a server-controlled FILEDESCRIPTORW cFileName with unbounded _wcschr() and count_special_chars() calls without a NUL-termination guarantee. title: FreeRDP 3.9.0 before 3.32.0 RDPEAR NDR Scalar Out-of-Bounds Read
desc: FreeRDP from 3.9.0 before 3.32.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the RDPEAR NDR scalar readers, which check value length before consuming alignment padding. title: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 Invalid Memory Free in FX Operation
desc: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains an invalid memory free vulnerability in the fx operation that occurs when initialization of an FX runtime entry fails. Attackers can trigger the failed FX runtime initialization to cause an invalid free, resulting in memory corruption and application crashes.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in YUV Encoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the YUV encoder, which fails to release allocated memory when a specific operation fails. Attackers can supply crafted input that triggers the failing encoder operation, leaking memory and potentially exhausting resources to cause a denial of service.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Use After Free in PDF Writer via JPEG2000
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the PDF writer when writing CMYK images with JPEG2000 compression. Attackers can supply a crafted CMYK image that, when written to PDF with JPEG2000 compression, causes freed memory to be reused, potentially crashing the process.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Information Disclosure in PostScript Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the PostScript decoder, which allocates a buffer one byte longer than the data it decoded. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file to expose a single uninitialized byte of memory contents.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in Wavelet-Denoise Operation
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the wavelet-denoise operation, which fails to release allocated memory when a required resource cannot be acquired. Attackers can repeatedly trigger wavelet-denoise processing under resource-constrained conditions to leak memory and degrade service availability.

title: Open WebUI 0.11.1 before 0.11.4 Authorization Bypass via OAuth Token Exchange
desc: Open WebUI from 0.11.1 before 0.11.4 contains an authorization bypass in the OAuth token exchange endpoint, which reads role claims only from the provider's userinfo response and keeps the user's existing role when no roles claim is found, ignoring roles sent only in the ID token. title: Open WebUI before 0.11.4 Stored XSS via javascript: URLs in Markdown Links
desc: Open WebUI before 0.11.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in MarkdownInlineTokens.svelte, which renders markdown link URLs into anchor hrefs without validating their scheme. Authenticated users can embed javascript: links in shared chats that, when clicked by a victim, steal the victim's JWT from local storage, including admins' tokens.

title: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 Tool Source Disclosure via Tool Export Endpoint
desc: Open WebUI from 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users with tool export permission to obtain tool source code shared with them read-only. Attackers can request GET /api/v1/tools/export to retrieve the full Python source of read-only shared tools, exposing embedded API keys and credentials.

title: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 Memory Exhaustion via Knowledge Search Regex
desc: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 compiles user-chosen grep patterns for its knowledge and chat file search tools with a regex engine that expands nested counted repetition unbounded at compile time and caches the result. Authenticated users can have the model call grep_knowledge_files with short nested-repetition patterns, blocking the event loop and exhausting worker memory.

title: Parse Server before 8.6.93 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.1-alpha.13 protectedFields Bypass via Relation Count Query
desc: Parse Server before 8.6.93 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.1-alpha.13 does not enforce identity-scoped protectedFields (authenticated, role, or per-user groups) on count queries using the $relatedTo operator, exposing the size of protected Relation fields. desc: Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.7 and 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 passes the raw 'updates' request parameter in AppController::actionCacheUpdates to UpdatesModel without Component::cleanseConfig(), allowing behavior and event-handler injection. title: Grav Login Plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 2FA Bypass via Remember-Me Cookie
desc: Grav Login plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with a valid password to skip two-factor authentication through remember-me cookie restoration. Attackers can obtain a persistent remember-me cookie after the password step and restore it as a fully authorized session without completing the second factor.

title: Grav Git Sync 1.0.2 through 3.4.12 Command Injection via Commit Author
desc: Grav Git Sync 1.0.2 through 3.4.12 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated content editors to execute OS commands by injecting shell substitutions into profile fields. title: Grav Star Ratings 2.0.1 through 2.0.3 Missing Server-Side vote_access Authorization
desc: Grav Star Ratings 2.0.1 through 2.0.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to vote by bypassing client-only vote_access and readonly enforcement. Attackers can use the anonymous nonce emitted by getData() to submit votes directly to addVote(), manipulating restricted or disabled ratings and aggregate rating output.

title: Vercel deepsec before 1.1.17 Arbitrary File Write via Symlink in Sandbox Tarball Extraction
desc: Vercel deepsec from 0.1.0 before 1.1.17 contains a link following vulnerability in extractTarballLocally that allows sandboxed code to write files outside the sandbox by planting links in result tarballs. Attackers controlling sandbox code, such as a prompt-injected coding agent, can plant symbolic or hard links in the host data directory to write arbitrary files on the orchestrator host.

title: modern-tar 0.3.5 through 0.8.5 Memory Exhaustion via Malformed Octal Size Field
desc: modern-tar 0.3.5 through 0.8.5 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to produce negative entry sizes via non-octal bytes parsed by readOctal(). Attackers can supply a crafted, optionally gzip-compressed, archive to unpackTar() that buffers chunks indefinitely, exhausting process memory and suppressing later entries.

title: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 CSV Formula Injection via Exports
desc: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to inject spreadsheet formulas by supplying crafted registration, checkout or newsletter fields. desc: Telegram-Stremio through 5.1.0 contains an insecure storage vulnerability that allows attackers with access to the MongoDB database, backups, or logs to recover the operator's authenticated Telegram session string, which is protected only by a keyless, reversible encoding transform rather than actual encryption. desc: Continue CLI (@continuedev/cli) through 1.5.47 contains a permission bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to run unapproved commands by chaining them after allowed Bash prefix rules. title: Rapyd Admin 9.4.0 before 9.20.0 Stored XSS via select-list Component
desc: Rapyd Admin from 9.4.0 before 9.20.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through self-registered display names. Attackers can register with an HTML or JavaScript name rendered unescaped in the Activity log Author filter, executing in an administrator's session.

desc: Information disclosure in the WebRTC: Networking component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 158.

title: Authentication Bypass Vulnerability in Certain NETGEAR RAX Series Models

desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saveDatarule handler of SysDepartRoleController that lets low-privileged authenticated users modify department role data rules. title: Tabularis through 0.27.0 Read-Only Bypass via MCP run_query SELECT Classification
desc: Tabularis through 0.27.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the MCP run_query safety gate that allows prompt-injected agents or untrusted MCP clients to bypass read-only mode by submitting side-effecting SELECT statements. Attackers can run statements like SELECT setval, nextval, or PostgreSQL query_to_xml with embedded DELETE to modify data without approval prompts.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 IDOR via /airag/voice/listByUser userId Parameter
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other users' AI voice generation history via the userId parameter of GET /airag/voice/listByUser. Attackers who know another user's id can retrieve submitted text-to-speech input, voice settings, timestamps, and generated audio file names and paths stored in Redis.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /airag/extData/exportXls
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AiragExtDataController exportXls handler that allows any authenticated user to export AI evaluator data. Low-privileged attackers can request /airag/extData/exportXls to download every user's airag_ext_data evaluator definitions and test-tracking records as an Excel workbook.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via sysMessageTemplate deleteBatch Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete message templates via the DELETE /sys/message/sysMessageTemplate/deleteBatch endpoint. Attackers can supply comma-separated template ids from the unguarded list endpoint to delete all sys_sms_template rows, breaking template-based notifications such as workflow reminders.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via sysMessage deleteBatch Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysMessageController deleteBatch handler that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete message records. Attackers can obtain record ids from the unguarded list endpoint and submit them to deleteBatch to remove any message push records, including pending queued messages.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via sysDepartPermission datarule Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saveDatarule handler of SysDepartPermissionController that allows any authenticated user to modify department data rules. Low-privileged attackers can send departId, permissionId and dataRuleIds to POST /sys/sysDepartPermission/datarule to change, add or clear data rules on any department-menu permission binding.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via sysDepartPermission deleteBatch Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete department permission bindings via the DELETE /sys/sysDepartPermission/deleteBatch endpoint. Attackers can obtain row ids from the unguarded list endpoint and submit them in the ids parameter to remove menus and buttons departments can grant to their roles.

desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to permanently delete data dictionaries via the deletePhysic handler of SysDictController. Low-privileged attackers can send DELETE requests to /sys/dict/deletePhysic/{id} to irreversibly remove active dictionaries and all their items, bypassing the recycle bin.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/category/delete
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysCategoryController delete handler that allows any authenticated user to delete category dictionary nodes. Low-privileged attackers can obtain node ids from the unguarded rootList and childList endpoints and delete entire sys_category subtrees, breaking dependent forms and dictionary fields.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/api/queryUserRolesById
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the queryUserRolesById handler of SystemApiController that lets authenticated users read any user's role codes. Low-privileged attackers can send a userId to GET /sys/api/queryUserRolesById to enumerate role assignments and identify administrator accounts.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/oss/file/queryById
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OssFileController queryById handler that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read object storage file records. Attackers who know a record id can request GET /sys/oss/file/queryById to obtain original file names and direct storage URLs of files uploaded by other users.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/tenant/listPackByTenantUserId
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysTenantController listPackByTenantUserId handler that allows any authenticated user to query tenant product packs. Low-privileged attackers can supply arbitrary tenantId and userId parameters to enumerate any tenant's product pack configuration and reveal which users are tenant administrators.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /airag/prompts/queryById
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AiragPromptsController queryById handler that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read any AI prompt template. Attackers can enumerate ids via the unguarded /airag/prompts/list endpoint and query each one to obtain prompt text, model parameters, and creator details belonging to administrators or other users.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /airag/knowledge/embedding/search
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the embeddingSearch handler of AiragKnowledgeController that lacks Shiro permission annotations. An authenticated, low-privileged user with Content View permissions in one organization may be able to access and modify filter rules belonging to a Content View Filter in another organization by supplying that filter's identifier. title: Prenotazioni <= 1.7.5 - Unauthenticated Stored XSS via Settings Update
desc: The Prenotazioni WordPress plugin through 1.7.5 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks when saving its settings, and does not escape some of them when outputting them, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators and site visitors.

title: Mobile builder <= 1.4.2 - Subscriber+ Privilege Escalation to Admin
desc: The Mobile builder WordPress plugin through 1.4.2 does not properly restrict which user meta keys a logged-in user can update through one of its REST routes, allowing any user with a self-registered account, such as a customer, to grant themselves the administrator role.

title: Mobile Builder <= 1.4.2 - Unauthenticated SQLi via 'vendor_id' Parameter
desc: The Mobile builder WordPress plugin through 1.4.2 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing unauthenticated users to perform SQL injection attacks.

title: Anton Extensions <= 1.2.2 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload to RCE
desc: The Anton Extensions WordPress plugin through 1.2.2 does not perform any capability check, nonce verification, or file-type validation before writing attacker-supplied content to an attacker-chosen path, allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary PHP files and achieve remote code execution.

title: Envira Gallery < 1.16.2 - Author+ Non-Public Post Title and Excerpt Disclosure via Gallery REST Field
desc: The Envira Gallery  WordPress plugin before 1.16.2 does not verify that an image identifier added to a gallery refers to a media attachment the caller is permitted to view, allowing any user able to create and edit a gallery (Author and above by default) to disclose the title and excerpt of other users' private, draft, pending and trashed posts that WordPress would otherwise withhold from them.

desc: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Delight Star Inc. WP Associate Post R2 wp-associate-post-r2 allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects WP Associate Post R2: from n/a through 5.0.1.

title: WordPress Product Configurator for WooCommerce plugin <= 1.7.5 - PHP Object Injection vulnerability
desc: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in mklacroix Product Configurator for WooCommerce product-configurator-for-woocommerce allows Object Injection.This issue affects Product Configurator for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.7.5.

title: WordPress Jetpack plugin <= 16.2 - Broken Authentication vulnerability
desc: Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel vulnerability in Automattic Jetpack jetpack allows Password Recovery Exploitation.This issue affects Jetpack: from n/a through 16.2.

title: WordPress AI Translation for Polylang plugin <= 1.6.2 - Broken Access Control vulnerability
desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cool Plugins AI Translation for Polylang automatic-translations-for-polylang allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects AI Translation for Polylang: from n/a through 1.6.2.

title: Post Snippets <= 4.2.4 - Contributor+ Stored XSS via Snippet Variable
desc: The Post Snippets  WordPress plugin through 4.2.4 does not properly escape variable values substituted into snippets before outputting them, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to inject arbitrary web scripts that execute when the content is viewed.
